facts.fact: Prime Minister Dlamini applauded the Eswatini Institute of Management and Public Administration (EIMPA) for offering online and physical cybersecurity training for civil servants in October 2025.

facts.fact: Prime Minister Dlamini announced that the Eswatini Communications Commission has been formally designated the National Cybersecurity Agency, with a fully operational Cyber Incident Response Team.
The Prime Minister cited the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027 as part of the country's digital defence framework.
The Prime Minister said the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act was passed in 2022, and the article's highlights say three major cyber laws and the national strategy are now in force.
The Prime Minister said the Data Protection Act was passed in 2022, and the article's highlights say three major cyber laws are now in force.
